verdict.rationale: The AMD Instinct MI325X is a GPU accelerator with a software stack (ROCm, SMI, Kubernetes operator), not a hosted service with an API. Issuing scoped API credentials for an agent is a category error for this kind of product, and nothing in the evidence shows it ships such a capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
